notes: Reviewed at 2.3. Local event: request fields, path construction, the fix's empty-category check and the file write are all in set_personality_config. Verified at 104293d: lollms/security.py::sanitize_path (unchanged by the fix) accepts an empty string (no leading '/', no '..'/'//', Path('').is_absolute() is False, no forbidden chars) and a name like 'home/u/lollms/configs'; package_path = f'{category}/{name}' becomes '/home/u/lollms/configs', which pathlib treats as absolute so personalities_zoo_path / package_path discards the zoo base; if <that dir>/config.yaml exists it is overwritten with the attacker's config dict via yaml.safe_dump (advisory: overwrite configs/config.yaml, then RCE via force_accept_remote_access / turn_on_code_validation). At eda3af5 the added `if category=="": return error` rejects that input before the path is built; forbid_remote_access(lollmsElfServer) is added as well (defence in depth, blocks the endpoint when the host is not localhost unless force_accept_remote_access). Parallel flows closed by the same commit but not modelled: get_personality_config (read), mount_personality, remount_personality, unmount_personality, get_personality_settings in the same file.
